biome_box.name: Biome Box (the biome in a transparent grid box)
biome_box.description: The biome in a transparent grid box. A glass box six metres square, the size of a shaft's opening, with the biome's own cell lines carried out onto the glass one metre apart; inside it biome_object, one ground from one seed, the same in every box down the tower. What differs from floor to floor is the stage: the biome may only be made of what the halls above have taught (the biome vocabulary), and phase says how far what arrives with this floor's sequence has come. A run of boxes down one shaft is one world growing as the visitor descends: on the L-system floors the tree and the creature arrive. The box closes the shaft and keeps a body out. It stays an empty grid with its seed until a body arrives on its floor, because the biome's builders take about a second. A slanted form (flare_height above 0) stands on the same foot on the shaft's rim, leans its four glass sides outward to a larger ground carried that high, and leaves the top open: cells 12 with flare_height 2 is a twelve-metre ground two metres up, built in about two seconds. A window form (window true) is only a clear glass floor set flush in the opening, with the metre lines on it: a body walks out on it and looks down at the biome of the floor below, and the window asks the box under it to build, because the floor under a body is paused. With gate_side the slanted form is walked: two metres of the upright glass are left out, a board runs from a deck outside down onto the ground, and the ground carries the body.
biome_box.qfep_connection: The same ground is asked again on every floor what it is allowed to be: what a place can grow is a matter of what has been taught above it.
